hypotheses.text: Engineering of pH-dependent antibody binding selectivity can achieve up to 25-fold improvement toward acidic pH relative to a parental bH1-Fab in the reported engineering study.
hypotheses.rationale: PMC6927761 supports the study-specific 25-fold selectivity observation; methodology, assay conditions and generalization still require full-text review.

hypotheses.text: pH-sensitive Fcabs can be isolated without histidine mutations, at least in the three Fcabs described.
hypotheses.rationale: PMC4314675 supports the observation that two of three isolated pH-sensitive Fcabs lacked histidine mutations; mechanism and broader applicability remain unresolved.

key_uncertainties: Generalization beyond the reported bH1-Fab system is not established.
Mechanism of pH sensitivity in Fcabs lacking histidine mutations is unresolved from the reviewed excerpt.
Cross-study differences in format, assay conditions and engineering strategy prevent direct mechanistic equivalence.
recommended_checks: Inspect full methods and assay conditions for both studies.
Compare pH windows, binding readouts, controls and replication.
Assess whether independent studies reproduce histidine-independent and structure-guided pH switching.

note: Permanent compact summary of the GitHub Actions artifact; does not replace the original artifact or establish scientific correctness.
